'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Jerry Heine DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' where is pancakes House?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
